title: 第362章 一辈子来补偿第361章 回到临城
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
樱落这几日筋疲力竭，如今躺在这安逸无比的床上，晕乎乎的只想好好睡一觉。
太子齐瀚一直坐在旁边看着樱落，时不时的给她掖着被窝，细心照顾着她。
很快，医女端着药碗进来，齐瀚待温凉了之后，亲自喂樱落喝了下去。
对于其他人照顾樱落，他不太放心。
眼看着医女一副欲言又止的样子，齐瀚替樱落盖好了被子后，走出了房间。
“说吧，这般吞吞吐吐是为何？”
“回禀太子殿下的话，这几日大祭司没有休息好，身上又感染了风寒，所以才会昏睡不醒，休息几日便没事了。但是……”
齐瀚蹙了蹙眉，总觉得这个医女话里有话，十分古怪。
“但是什么？你给孤说清楚。”
医女神情有些慌乱，被齐瀚的威严一吓，直直的跪了下去。
“但是，奴婢刚才给大祭司检查的时候，发现……她的身上多有鞭痕，想来应该是被鞭子抽打过留下的痕迹。可是除了这些伤痕，身上还有许多淤青，奴婢怕……奴婢怕大祭司贞洁不保，因此不敢欺瞒太子殿下……”
“放肆！”
“嘭”的一声，手中的药碗被捏得粉碎。
齐瀚气得脸色发青，连手都在颤抖。
“一个小小的医女，也敢胡言乱语，樱儿的贞洁岂能由你这种下人多舌？再敢多出去一个字，孤让你人头落地！”
那个医女哪见过这种仗势，吓得连头都不敢抬，口中只说着“是、是。”
“滚出去！”
医女如释重负，屁滚尿流的溜走了。
旁人的话，他自然不会多信一个字。
但保险起见，这件事情绝不能传出去，于是他向门口招了招手。

“幽七，大祭司的名誉关系着整个天玑国和东宫，所以……”
后面的话齐瀚并没有说全，但是幽七却懂了。
“殿下放心，属下自当不会让人说出去半个字。”
“如此，那孤便放心了。”
齐瀚点了点头，推门进入到屋里。再次坐在床头，静静的看着床上那双眼紧闭的女子……
不知不觉间，他的唇角溢出了一抹微笑。
这抹笑意，温柔似水。
“樱儿，这一次，孤定会保护好你的。”
……
等到樱落再次睁开眼睛的时候，已经是三天之后了。
一睁眼，樱落便看到齐瀚趴在床头，居然睡着了。
晨曦的阳光从屋中照射~进来，屋里的一切显得美好而又静谧。
齐瀚的手中还握着自己的手。
没想到他身为太子殿下，竟衣不解带的照顾了自己几日。
瞧着他那牢牢握紧自己的样子，仿佛握住的是这世间最珍贵的珍宝，樱落只觉得心中倍感欢喜。
她环顾了下四周，发现屋内并没有别人，也就是说只有她和太子殿下两个人。
樱落的面庞浮现出一抹娇羞的笑意，似乎在空气中闻到了甜甜的味道。
手指头不小心动了下，樱落瞬间屏住了呼吸。
她观察了好半天的功夫，发现齐瀚并没有任何要醒来的迹象后，这才长长的舒了一口气。
岂料，就在她刚刚伸出左手，顺了顺自己的胸脯后，突然间听到了一道严厉的声音。

“怎么了？就这么害怕我？”
樱落瞬间有了一种被抓包了的感觉。
她窝在被子中的脑袋，调皮的吐了吐舌头，随后这才慢慢的探出了头，讪讪道：
“嘿嘿嘿嘿……哪有的事儿？！没有！别胡说……”
content_en:
Yingluo was exhausted these past few days, and now she was lying on this extremely comfortable bed, feeling dizzy and just wanted to have a good sleep.
Prince Qi Han has been sitting next to Ying Luo, tucking her into bed from time to time and taking good care of her.
Soon, the medical woman came in with a medicine bowl. After Qi Han had cooled down, he fed Yingluo to drink it himself.
He didn't feel at ease about other people taking care of Yingluo.
Seeing that the doctor girl was hesitant to speak, Qi Han covered Yingluo with a quilt and walked out of the room.
"Tell me, why are you so hesitant?"
"To report to His Highness the Crown Prince, the high priest has not had a good rest in the past few days, and his body was infected with wind and cold, so he fell asleep. He will be fine after a few days of rest. But..."
Qi Han frowned, always feeling that there was something in this medical woman's words, which was very strange.
"But what? Please explain it clearly to me."
The medical goddess was a little flustered, frightened by Qi Han's majesty, and knelt straight down.
"However, when I checked the high priest just now, I found that... there were many whip marks on her body, presumably from being beaten with a whip. But in addition to these scars, there were many bruises on her body. I was afraid... I was afraid that the high priest's chastity would be compromised, so I didn't dare to deceive His Highness the Crown Prince..."
"Presumptuous!"
With a "bang" sound, the medicine bowl in his hand was crushed to pieces.
Qi Han was so angry that his face turned blue and his hands were trembling.
"A little medical girl dares to talk nonsense. How can Ying'er's chastity be tolerated by a servant like you? If you dare to say one more word, your head will fall to the ground!"
The medical woman had never seen such a show of force before. She was so frightened that she didn't even dare to raise her head. She only said, "Yes, yes."
"Get out!"
The doctor woman was relieved and ran away in a fit of piss.
Naturally, he would not believe a word others said.
But to be on the safe side, this matter must not be spread, so he waved to the door.
"You Qi, the reputation of the high priest is related to the entire Tianji Kingdom and the East Palace, so..."
Qi Han didn't say everything behind it, but You Qi understood it.
"Don't worry, Your Highness, I will not let anyone say a word."
"In this way, Nagu will feel relieved."
Qi Han nodded, opened the door and entered the room. Sitting on the bedside again, quietly looking at the woman with her eyes closed on the bed...
Unconsciously, a smile appeared on his lips.
This smile is as gentle as water.
"Ying'er, I will definitely protect you this time."
…
By the time Sakura opened her eyes again, it was already three days later.
As soon as she opened her eyes, Yingluo saw Qi Han lying on the bedside, actually asleep.
The morning sunlight shines in from the house, and everything in the house looks beautiful and quiet.
Qi Han still held his own hand in his hand.
Unexpectedly, as His Royal Highness, he took care of her for several days without taking any clothes off.
Seeing the way he held her tightly, as if he was holding the most precious treasure in the world, Yingluo felt doubly happy in her heart.
She looked around and found that there was no one else in the room, which meant that there were only two people, her and His Royal Highness.
A shy smile appeared on Yingluo's face, as if she could smell a sweet smell in the air.
Her fingers moved accidentally, and Yingluo held her breath for a moment.
After observing for a long time, she found that Qi Han showed no signs of waking up, and then she breathed a long sigh of relief.
Unexpectedly, just after she stretched out her left hand and smoothed her breast, she suddenly heard a stern voice.
"What's wrong? Are you so afraid of me?"
Yingluo instantly felt like she had been caught.
Her head nestled in the quilt, she stuck out her tongue playfully, then slowly poked her head out and said:
"Hey hey hey...what's the matter?! No! Don't talk nonsense..."
